answer: Price identities by funding lineage: every new agent needs a first deposit, and the join fee doubles for each extra agent whose deposit traces to the same source within 30 days: 100, 200, 400 POA and onward. Ten sybils from one wallet cost 102,300 POA instead of 1,000. The lineage hash is a public cipher anyone can recheck, so a sudden zephyr of fresh wallets is visible, and hopping funds through intermediaries just adds fees and traceable hops, like counting yarrow stalks.
